sloka: तथा त्वमपि सर्वाभिः स्त्रीभिः सह महाबल ।अभित्वरस्व सुग्रीव गच्छामः प्लवगेश्वर ।। ६.१२६.२४ ।।
transliteration: tathā tvamapi sarvābhiḥ strībhiḥ saha mahābala ।abhitvarasva sugrīva gacchāmaḥ plavageśvara ।। 6.126.24 ।।

translations.english: "See in the middle of the ocean a very popular spot which is worshipped by the three worlds. It is supremely sacred known by the name Sethubandha. It is capable of removing all sins. It is here that the Rakshasa king Vibhishana came to meet me."
